label: Updated at 12 p.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: McIlroy Criticizes DeChambeau
items.text: Rory McIlroy said Bryson DeChambeau is running out of options after LIV Golf's collapse and commented, “I’m not in his shoes, nor would I ever want to be,” regarding DeChambeau's attempt to join the DP World Tour.

items.headline: DeChambeau’s DP World Tour Decision
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau reportedly has days to decide on DP World Tour membership, a move that will affect where he can play top-level events next season and beyond.

items.headline: Tiger Woods Recovery Update
items.text: Tiger Woods, involved in a car crash in Florida in late March, has shared an update on his recovery progress.
